input: fixed DJI_0047_3__4621500__00000__00159, 160 native640x512 grayscales; all source annotations; no model predictions
pairing: Direct frame t to t+5 mapping; 155 pairs. Four 40-frame block summaries use 35 pairs wholly within each block; no cumulative integration.

affine.method: cv2.estimateAffine2D full affine RANSAC, source to destination

adjusted_displacement: norm(center[t+5] - A_t_to_t5*[center[t],1])/5; image-coordinate residual px/frame, not physical speed

annotation_audit.check: all 8 tracks, duplicate frame-ID, missing frames, positive bbox, inside bounds, consecutive center steps
annotation_audit.large_step_flag_px: max(8, 0.5*median max box side) per track, descriptive only
annotation_audit.visibility: continuous label presence does not establish continuous visibility

contrast.ring: bbox expanded 12px minus all boxes expanded 4px
contrast.summary: mean difference, p90(target)-median(ring), ring std; standardized p90 contrast divides by max(ring std,1); box-based diagnostic not target-mask SNR

subregion_diagnostic: inlier fitted residual split y<400 and y>=400; descriptive possible parallax clue, no independent physical-camera proof
no_tuning: retain initial outputs if criteria reject, do not loosen thresholds to achieve desired residual speed
inheritance: All algorithm parameters and validity thresholds unchanged from first clip; applies source-boundary amendment to intensity sampling.
